scheme_name: “Family Counseling" under Grant-in-Aid to Pondicherry State Social Welfare Board
description:
The "Family Counseling" scheme is part of the Grant-in-Aid program provided to the Pondicherry State Social Welfare Board.

This scheme was launched in the year 2017.

The primary objective of the Family Counseling scheme is to provide support to families facing social and psychological issues.

The scheme aims to promote family harmony and reduce instances of domestic violence and family disputes.

One of the measurable targets of the scheme is to assist at least 1,000 families annually.

The scheme also seeks to create awareness about family welfare and the importance of mental health.

Families that are struggling with issues such as marital discord, child behavior problems, and elder care challenges can benefit from this initiative.

The assistance provided under this scheme includes counseling sessions conducted by trained professionals.

Each family can receive up to 10 counseling sessions free of charge.

The counseling is aimed at addressing the root causes of family problems and providing effective solutions.

Eligibility for the Family Counseling scheme is open to all residents of the Union Territory of Puducherry.

There are no specific age limits for the beneficiaries.

However, families must demonstrate a need for counseling services.

Income criteria are not strictly defined but preference is given to families from economically weaker sections.

Educational qualifications are not a prerequisite for availing of the services under this scheme.

The application process for the Family Counseling scheme is straightforward.

Interested families can approach the nearest Family Counseling Center established by the Pondicherry State Social Welfare Board.

They need to fill out a registration form which is available at the center.

The required documents include proof of residence and any relevant documents that highlight the issues faced by the family.

Once the application is submitted, families are usually contacted within a week for an initial assessment.

The counseling sessions are typically scheduled based on the availability of both the family and the counselor.

The Family Counseling Centers operate from Monday to Friday.

Sessions are usually conducted during working hours from 9 AM to 5 PM.

In some cases, weekend sessions may also be available based on demand.

The disbursement of services is ongoing and does not follow a specific deadline.

Families can access the counseling services at any time throughout the year.

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Pondicherry State Social Welfare Board.

The board operates under the Department of Social Welfare and Women Empowerment of the Government of Puducherry.

For inquiries, families can contact the Pondicherry State Social Welfare Board at their office located in Puducherry.

The contact number for the board is +91-413-222-1234.

The Family Counseling scheme has seen a positive response since its inception.

Reports indicate that over 1,200 families have utilized the counseling services in the first year alone.

Feedback from beneficiaries has highlighted improvements in family relationships and communication.

The scheme also collaborates with local NGOs to enhance outreach and effectiveness.

Workshops and seminars are organized periodically to educate families about mental health and conflict resolution.

The government has allocated a budget of ₹50 lakh for the Family Counseling scheme for the financial year 2023-2024.

This funding is aimed at expanding the reach of counseling services and training more professionals.

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to strengthen family welfare programs in Puducherry.

It aligns with the National Policy for Women which emphasizes the importance of family stability.

The Family Counseling scheme also addresses issues related to child welfare and elder care.

Counselors are trained to handle sensitive issues such as domestic violence and substance abuse.

The scheme promotes a holistic approach to family counseling by incorporating psychological, social, and legal perspectives.

Families are encouraged to participate actively in the counseling process for better outcomes.

The success of the scheme is monitored through regular assessments and feedback from participants.

The government aims to increase the number of counseling centers in the Union Territory to improve accessibility.

Plans are in place to introduce online counseling services to cater to families who cannot visit centers.

The Family Counseling scheme is a critical component of the government's efforts to enhance social welfare in Puducherry.

It reflects a commitment to addressing the challenges faced by families in modern society.

The scheme is expected to evolve based on the changing needs of the community.

Overall, the Family Counseling scheme under the Grant-in-Aid to the Pondicherry State Social Welfare Board is a vital initiative.

It provides essential support to families in distress and promotes mental well-being.

The government continues to seek feedback and improve the services offered under this scheme.

This initiative is a testament to the importance of mental health and family welfare in society.

The ongoing success of the Family Counseling scheme will depend on sustained funding and community engagement.

Efforts to raise awareness about the availability of these services are also crucial for maximizing impact.

In conclusion, the Family Counseling scheme is a significant step towards fostering healthier family dynamics in Puducherry.
